uncited: Multi-view Consistency and Scoring is a family of densification strategies for 3D Gaussian Splatting that evaluates Gaussian primitives across multiple camera views to guide densification and pruning operations.
It builds on [Densification Strategy](6234-densification-strategy.md) by incorporating multi-view photometric loss and alpha contributions to identify regions requiring refinement or removal.

Unlike its siblings [Multi-view Alpha-based Densification and Pruning](15406-multi-view-alpha-based-densification-and-pruning.md) and [Multi-View Consistency Scoring for Densification](15464-multi-view-consistency-scoring-for-densification.md), this family explicitly integrates importance and pruning scores derived from multi-view photometric loss and alpha contributions into the standard gradient masks, ensuring that densification occurs only where geometry is consistently unresolved across views.
The shared principles for this family are defined in [Densification Strategy](6234-densification-strategy.md).
